exact_mathematical_review: Occurrence root wraps existing dependent PathStar root; Extension source target retains an actual typed base edge and equality of target occurrence with parent history.cons edge. Endpoint-only or vertex-list equality never replaces arrow identity.

Extension increases original history length by one. Unique incoming parent/last arrow follows from actual Path constructor injectivity; nil/cons analysis supplies root-or-parent. These are the precise premises of upstream arborescenceMk, rather than an assumed tree invariant.

OutgoingStarEquiv is actual edge projection with inverse canonical extension by that edge. Upstream Prefunctor.pathStar_bijective needs only outgoing star bijections, and yields unique finite path lifting from every chosen occurrence.

ofPath_comp_projection proves any actual lifted path ends at the occurrence whose stored history is source.path composed with its actual projected path. This is an equality of actual existing paths/occurrences, beyond an abstract fresh tree or merely vertex reachability.

Endpoint image is exactly base vertices with Nonempty(Path root target); full endpoint surjectivity is equivalent to that reachability condition. Generic statements need neither global reachability nor finiteness, countability, acyclicity, thin Hom, or decidable equality.

Every extension raises length, so empty occurrence has no incoming edge. Any base incoming edge at the root obstructs costar surjectivity and hence full IsCovering. Outgoing lifting does not discharge this missing costar premise.
